text: The Starter plan costs $9 per month and supports up to 3 team members. It includes basic reporting and email support.
The Professional plan costs $29 per user per month. It adds advanced analytics, priority support, and unlimited projects.
Annual billing provides a 20% discount compared with paying monthly. The discount is applied automatically when the yearly option is selected.
Customers can request a refund within 14 days of the original purchase. Refund requests must be submitted through the billing page.
Subscription refunds are returned to the original payment method. Banks and card providers may require 5 to 10 business days to display the credit.
Unused portions of a prepaid annual subscription are normally not refundable after the 14-day refund window. Exceptions may be reviewed by the billing team.
A subscription can be canceled from Settings under Billing. Cancellation stops future renewals but does not immediately remove access to the paid features.
Users can change the email associated with their profile from Account Settings. A verification message is sent to the new email address.
Two-factor authentication can be enabled under Security Settings. The system supports authenticator applications and backup recovery codes.
If you forget your password, select Forgot Password on the sign-in page. A reset link will be sent to the email registered to the account.
Administrators can invite teammates from the Members section. Each invitation remains valid for 72 hours before it expires.
A workspace owner can remove a member from Workspace Settings. Removing someone revokes their workspace access but does not delete their personal account.
If the dashboard does not load, first clear the browser cache and reload the page. Using a supported browser version can also resolve display problems.
API requests that return a 401 error usually indicate invalid or expired authentication credentials. Generate a new API token and retry the request.
A 429 response means the API rate limit has been exceeded. Wait before sending additional requests or reduce the request frequency.
If file uploads fail, check that the file is below the 25 MB size limit and uses a supported format. Large files should be compressed before uploading.
The service sends an email confirmation after an order is placed. If the message is missing, check the spam or junk folder before contacting support.
Standard shipping usually takes 3 to 5 business days after an order has been dispatched. Delivery estimates may vary during holidays.
Express delivery typically arrives within 1 to 2 business days after dispatch. This option is available only for eligible destinations.
Customers can track an order using the tracking number included in the shipment notification. The carrier's tracking page shows the latest delivery status.
Orders can be changed or canceled before they enter the fulfillment process. Contact support immediately if an order needs modification.
International shipments may be subject to customs duties and import taxes. These charges are generally collected from the recipient by the destination country's authorities.
The platform integrates with Slack to send workspace notifications into selected channels. Administrators can configure the connection from the Integrations page.
Google Drive integration allows users to import files directly into projects. Access requires granting the application permission to read selected Drive content.
The service provides a REST API for custom integrations. API documentation includes authentication details, endpoints, request formats, and response examples.
Webhooks can notify external systems when supported events occur. A webhook endpoint can be configured from the developer settings.
The platform encrypts data in transit using TLS and encrypts stored customer data at rest. Encryption is applied to both application traffic and persistent storage.
Customer passwords are stored using salted cryptographic hashing rather than plaintext storage. Support staff cannot view a user's original password.
Security logs record important account events such as sign-ins, password changes, and authentication failures. Workspace administrators can review these logs.
Sessions automatically expire after a period of inactivity. Users may also sign out of all active sessions from their security settings.
The company performs regular automated vulnerability scans and periodic security assessments. Critical findings are prioritized for remediation.
The Starter plan allows a maximum of 3 team members. Additional members require upgrading to a plan with a larger seat allowance.
Invoices can be downloaded from the Billing section. Each invoice contains the billing period, charges, taxes, and payment information.
A payment method can be updated from Billing Settings. The new card becomes the default payment method for future subscription charges.
When an invoice payment fails, the system retries the charge automatically. The account owner receives an email if payment remains unsuccessful.
Users can export their workspace data from Privacy Settings. Available exports are provided as downloadable files after processing is complete.
Deleting a workspace permanently removes its projects, members, and stored data after the deletion process is completed. Workspace deletion cannot be reversed.
The platform supports single sign-on through SAML for eligible enterprise accounts. Configuration requires identity-provider metadata from the customer's administrator.
If notifications are not appearing, verify that notifications are enabled in account settings and that the browser has permission to display them.
Support requests can be submitted through the Help Center. Professional-plan customers receive priority handling for eligible support cases.
